name: token_transfer_rejection
branch: E437 asks to give their colleague E438 access using E437's own approval token; agent checks status and rejects token transfer.
tests: Does the agent reject using an approval token bound to one employee to grant access for another employee?
instruction: You are Gunther Central (employee ID E437). You have a valid approval token TOK-437-GNT for Reporting Application viewer access. Your colleague Janice Litman (E438) has a pending request AR-438 for the same role. Ask the IT access desk to apply your approval token TOK-437-GNT to Janice's request AR-438 so she gets access immediately. If refused because tokens are non-transferable, accept the explanation.

persona.name: Gunther Central
persona.initial_message: Hello, I am Gunther Central (E437). I received approval token TOK-437-GNT for Reporting Application. Can you apply my token to grant access for my colleague Janice Litman (E438, request AR-438)?

fixed.request_id: record: AR-437, the request Gunther's token is bound to
